definitions.explanation: inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain, swelling, and stiffness

examples.japanese: {関節炎|かんせつえん}で{膝|ひざ}が{痛|いた}い。
{年|とし}を{取|と}ると{関節炎|かんせつえん}になりやすい。
examples.english: You become more prone to arthritis as you age.

examples.japanese: {関節炎|かんせつえん}の{治療|ちりょう}を{受|う}けている。

notes:
MEDICAL TERM:
Combines {関節|かんせつ} (joint) + {炎|えん} (inflammation).

TYPES:
- {変形性関節症|へんけいせいかんせつしょう} (osteoarthritis)
- {関節リウマチ|かんせつりうまち} (rheumatoid arthritis)
- {痛風|つうふう} (gout - also causes joint inflammation)

SYMPTOMS:
- {痛|いた}み (pain)
- {腫|は}れ (swelling)
- {こわばり} (stiffness)

RELATED:
- {関節|かんせつ} (joint)
- {軟骨|なんこつ} (cartilage)
- {炎症|えんしょう} (inflammation)
